newsitem.title: USA: Teardrop Golf names finance chief.
newsitem.headline: Teardrop Golf names finance chief.

text.p: TearDrop Golf Co said Thursday it appointed Joseph Cioni as vice president of finance and chief financial officer, effective immediately.
Cioni, a former vice president and chief financial officer of Remington Product Co, is filing a new position, Rudy Slucker, chairman and chief executive of TearDrop, said.
Before his job at Remington, Cioni, 57, held positions at Coopers & Lybrand, and was general manager, senior vice president of finance and chief financial officer for Pollio Dairy Products Corp.
